_note: Baidu aerial and roadside views of the domed terminal, plus an Esri World Imagery satellite view.

shj-baidu-1.webp.zh: 空中俯瞰：沙迦国际机场一连串白色穹顶的航站楼，右侧立着塔台，后方是跑道与荒原。
shj-baidu-1.webp.en: Aerial view of Sharjah's row of white domed terminal buildings, the control tower to the right and runways stretching into the desert.

shj-baidu-2.webp.zh: 黄昏时分的机场大道：环形路口前方的绿地一路通向远处的沙迦机场穹顶航站楼。
shj-baidu-2.webp.en: At dusk along the airport road, a landscaped roundabout leading towards Sharjah's domed terminal in the distance.

shj-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，沙迦国际机场（SHJ）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
shj-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Sharjah International Airport (SHJ) and its surroundings are clearly visible.
